description: Portable gold SQL is reused verbatim only when explicitly listed; dialect-specific SQL is independently frozen in queries.

queries.B036: SELECT to_char(o.purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS review_count, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score),4) AS average_review_score FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE to_char(o.purchase_timestamp,'YYYY') = '2018' GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY month
queries.B038: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(price),2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B039: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B040: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),4) AS cancellation_pct FROM orders GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*)>=100 ORDER BY cancellation_pct DESC, month LIMIT 5
queries.B041: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY') AS year, ROUND(SUM(price),2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
queries.B042: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY')||'-Q'||EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM purchase_timestamp)::INTEGER::TEXT AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
queries.B043: SELECT to_char(o.purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) AS payment_value FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B044: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(freight_value),2) AS freight_value FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B045: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(delivered_on_time) AS measured_orders, ROUND(AVG(delivered_on_time)*100,2) AS on_time_delivery_pct FROM order_delivery_metrics GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B046: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(item_value)/COUNT(*),2) AS average_order_value FROM order_financials WHERE status='delivered' AND to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY')='2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B047: WITH category_year AS (SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY') AS year, category_name, SUM(price) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' AND to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY') IN ('2017','2018') GROUP BY year,category_name), ranked AS (SELECT year,category_name,delivered_gmv,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY year ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC,category_name) AS rn FROM category_year) SELECT year,category_name,ROUND(delivered_gmv,2) AS delivered_gmv FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY year
queries.B051: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(price),2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' AND purchase_timestamp>='2018-08-01' AND purchase_timestamp<'2018-11-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B052: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE purchase_timestamp>='2017-10-01' AND purchase_timestamp<'2018-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B053: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),4) AS cancellation_pct FROM orders WHERE purchase_timestamp>='2018-01-01' AND purchase_timestamp<'2018-07-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.B075: WITH monthly AS (SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month,SUM(price) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY month), compared AS (SELECT month,delivered_gmv,LAG(delivered_gmv) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS previous_gmv FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(delivered_gmv,2) AS delivered_gmv,ROUND((delivered_gmv-previous_gmv)*100.0/previous_gmv,2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM compared WHERE month='2017-02'
queries.B080: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_in_both_years FROM (SELECT product_id FROM product_sales WHERE order_status='delivered' AND to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY') IN ('2017','2018') GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY'))=2) AS products_by_year
queries.B086: SELECT to_char(purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS month,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE purchase_timestamp>='2030-01-01' AND purchase_timestamp<'2031-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
